scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && npm run check:core-boundary && npm run check:contracts
scripts.check:fast: cargo fmt --all --check && npm run lint && npm run check && npm run lint:docs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:shell
scripts.precommit: git diff --cached --check && npm run check:fast && npm run test:fast
scripts.prepush: npm run prepush:rust && npm run prepush:packages && npm run prepush:policy
scripts.prepush:full: npm run prepush && npm run build:wasm-hosts && npm run test:browser --workspace @corca-ai/wasmppt && npm run build:pages && npm run test:pages && node benchmarks/run.mjs --ci
scripts.prepush:packages: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run check:core-boundary && npm run check:contracts
scripts.prepush:policy: cargo deny check bans licenses sources && cargo machete --skip-target-dir
scripts.prepush:rust: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked --offline && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked --offline -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --all-features --locked --offline --lib --tests && cargo test --workspace --all-features --locked --offline --doc && cargo check --workspace --all-features --locked --offline --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.test:fast: cargo test --workspace --lib --all-features --locked --offline && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
